technical-summary: VTP43: two opt-in packed KV cache types for paged attention, --kv-cache-dtype bf16_fp8 (bf16 K, E4M3 V, 768 B a token and head at head_dim 256) and bf16_i8 (bf16 K, int8 V with an f16 scale per 32 dims, 784 B), as patches rad0037 and rad0038 in the kv-bf16-packed experiment (state untested, not in the production source). Qwen3.8-27B long-corpus KLD against a same-build bf16 reference: fp8 0.00495, bf16_fp8 0.00323, bf16_i8 0.00269 mean; capacity 1.34x and 1.31x bf16; decode and TTFT within 3% of fp8. The per-document p99.9 <= 1 bar is not met (docs with far-repeated exact strings flip under any cache change, bf16 across builds included). libr3's rewrite tool gains `@@ find N or 0` block pairs so gfx1100 native rewrites can anchor on both production and patched text.
user-summary-candidate: Experimental bf16-key packed KV caches (bf16_fp8, bf16_i8) for the radiance engine: about 1.3x the cache capacity of bf16 with long-context quality between bf16 and fp8. Experiment-only until qualified on a second model.
